note: Registry data could NOT be verified in this session: the search backend (searx) returned connection refused for all queries, Bing/Google returned only irrelevant US 'Metro' results or 429, and all registry mirrors tried (zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com, tofler.in, falconebiz.com) returned HTTP 403, instafinancials.com returned only its generic landing page / 404. Therefore CIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, MCA status and audited revenue FY25/FY26 are all null - not public via accessible sources here, and must not be guessed. What IS confirmed from the company's own site (metrotyres.com/about-us and /contact-us, fetched): the operating entity presents itself as 'Metro Tyres Limited', describes itself as a tyre/tube manufacturer since 1968 with 7 manufacturing units, ~30 mln tyres + 30 mln tubes annual capacity, 53+ export countries, USD 140 mln group turnover, and lists Ludhiana (Punjab) manufacturing plants plus a Noida corporate office and a New Delhi address. Role therefore assessed as manufacturer (own plants, OEM supplies to Bajaj Auto, Piaggio, HMSI, Suzuki, Hero/Atlas/TI Cycles claimed). Note the input mixes 'Limited', 'Ltd' and 'Pvt Ltd' variants - the website consistently uses 'Metro Tyres Limited'; the 'Pvt Ltd' variants are likely a different/legacy entity and were not verified. No rejection basis found (no evidence of strike-off/liquidation/bankruptcy), but MCA status remains unverified. HS codes 401150/401320/401390 (tyres/tubes) are consistent with the declared activity - no HS correction needed. Revenue figures: null - the site's 'USD 140 Million conglomerate' is a self-declared group figure, not an audited FY25/FY26 filing, so it is not used.
